output.body: Isomorph: power(2, n) computes 2^n. The base case is power(2, 0) = 1, since any number to the power 0 is 1, and that stops the calls. The recursive case is power(2, n) = 2 * power(2, n-1), because 2^n is 2 times 2^(n-1), so each call moves n one step closer to 0.
output.key_idea: A recursive function needs a base case that stops the calls and a recursive case that calls the function again on a smaller input.
